answer: Every gate decision must append one gate.decision.v1 record to command-center/events/EVENTS.jsonl (JSONL, hash-chained per CC-0007). The record must carry predicted_class (POSITIVE=fired / NEGATIVE=silent), ground_truth_class (POSITIVE=should-fire / NEGATIVE=should-not / UNLABELLED), truth_source, input_fingerprint, gate_id, command, exit_code, denominator_eligible, and confusion. Unlabelled rows stay out of the denominator. On this worktree command-center/events/EVENTS.jsonl is present (2 line records, 0 event_type=gate.decision rows, verbs=['note', 'note'], union_keys=['id', 'note', 'ts', 'verb']). Replaying those JSONL rows through the proposed record: already-present=['ts']; would-have-to-be-added-or-proxy=['schema_version', 'event_type', 'record_id', 'gate_id', 'command', 'exit_code', 'predicted_class', 'ground_truth_class', 'truth_source', 'input_fingerprint', 'fixture_id', 'denominator_eligible', 'confusion', 'shell', 'git_rev', 'worktree_id', 'prev_digest', 'digest']; labelled=0. Probe1 field coverage is a live replay of 2007 existing gate-like probe JSON files (validate/measure/strike/SUBAGENT-RETURN), not a fabricated JSONL. Native ground_truth_class count on that harvest is 0. No FP or FN rate is quoted. Minimum sample: n>=30 labelled decisions of the quoted class and >=5 of the complementary class (rule-of-three 95% upper at n=30 is 10.0%). SUCCESS:RES-0099 in the receipt AND a field-coverage report against real existing events plus a stated minimum-sample threshold

fields.why: fixture | human-adjudication | planted-canary. Unsourced labels cannot audit the rate.

fields.why: sha256 of the bytes the gate actually saw, not of a later rewritten artifact.

fields.why: Membership in the labelled set published before the measurement.

fields.why: False when unlabelled. Prevents mixing live traffic into a quoted rate.

field_coverage.note: Primary probe1 corpus is a live replay of existing gate-like JSON under command-center/p2-wave/probes (validate/measure/strike/SUBAGENT-RETURN), excluding RES-0099. Catalog-named command-center/events/EVENTS.jsonl is replayed separately in events_jsonl_coverage because it is JSONL, not a single JSON object.

min_sample.why: A binomial rate with 0 observed errors has a 95% rule-of-three upper bound of 3/n. At n=30 that bound is 10.0%. Quoting 0% FP or FN below that n is an overclaim. The complementary-class floor of 5 is the REL-0019 rule: a gate with no known-bad fixture has an unmeasurable false-negative rate and must be published NOT-CHECKED, never given a passing threshold.

minimum_sample.why: A binomial rate with 0 observed errors has a 95% rule-of-three upper bound of 3/n. At n=30 that bound is 10.0%. Quoting 0% FP or FN below that n is an overclaim. The complementary-class floor of 5 is the REL-0019 rule: a gate with no known-bad fixture has an unmeasurable false-negative rate and must be published NOT-CHECKED, never given a passing threshold.

negative_controls.claim: 0 fires in 10 known-good trials is 0% FP
negative_controls.why: rule-of-three 95% upper bound at n=10 is 30%

negative_controls.claim: a gate with only known-good traffic has FN=0
negative_controls.why: FN is unmeasurable without known-bad fixtures

record_design.truth_negative_means: the input should not have fired (known-good fixture)
record_design.truth_positive_means: the input should have fired the gate (known-bad fixture or adjudicated defect)
record_design.why_there: The catalog already names command-center/events/EVENTS.jsonl as the append-only decision log (CC-0007 hash chain). A second log would split the denominator. New event_type=gate.decision rows append; they do not rewrite history.

residual_unknowns: command-center/events/EVENTS.jsonl exists but holds only verb=note rows and zero gate.decision records, so a live FP/FN rate remains unmeasurable.
No labelled known-good/known-bad fixture set for the live delivery gate is on disk here, so this unit designs the record and refuses to quote a rate.

reviewer.notes: Independent signal is the min-sample control (n=10 must refuse; n=30 with complementary class may quote). Not a second same-vendor read of the same coverage table.
